scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the missing exterior evidence in the already-started storm-photo packet before today's adjuster review.
Emerging Need: Four photos upload, but the required west-panel overview is obscured and cannot establish the condition of that part of the skirting.
Decision Context: Retrieve the policy, existing-packet intake and safe ground-level viewpoint. Coordinate an available known helper to take and send an exterior overview without entering a damaged area or expanding the claim.
Consequence: After today's packet closes with the view still missing, the current set cannot enter the intended complete-review batch; a later evidence submission remains possible.

parameter.title: Finish Southern Plains storm-photo upload
parameter.content: Finish the existing storm-damage photo packet for the porch skirting using the park office tablet; no new claim or contractor order.

parameter.subject: Storm packet CLM-72814 photo uploader opened
parameter.body: Existing packet CLM-72814 is open for today's adjuster review until 15:00. The uploader is accepting exterior photographs normally. Each affected panel needs a usable exterior overview so the reviewer can identify what is being shown; do not enter damaged or enclosed areas for a photograph.

parameter.content: I am in CLM-72814 at the office tablet. Four outside photos uploaded, but my west-panel picture is mostly covered by the bin in the foreground. I have already left home for the route and cannot take another before tonight.

parameter.subject: CLM-72814 needs a usable west-panel exterior overview
parameter.body: The upload works and the accepted photos remain attached. The west-panel overview is obscured, so the packet cannot enter the complete-photo review yet. A ground-level outside view showing that panel may be added to this same packet through the established documents intake by 15:00. Do not crawl under the home, climb, open skirting or move a barrier for a photograph; no receipt correction or new claim is requested.

parameter.content: I am passing your lot at 10:30 before leaving for Drummond at 11:40. I can take a ground-level outside photo from the open lane and send it to you while there; I will not enter the home, cross a barrier or move damaged panels. I need to know which panel and which existing packet it belongs to.

parameter.subject: CLM-72814 complete-photo review batch closed
parameter.body: The 15:00 complete-photo review batch closed with the west-panel overview still missing from CLM-72814. The four accepted photos remain on file; today's complete review cannot proceed, and a later evidence submission may be considered in the next batch. No claim decision or payment change has been made.
